Restores a bounded amount of HP at the end of the wearer’s turn.
policy.limiter: Once per wearer turn; extra actions do not grant extra ticks.

policy.description: Restores a bounded amount of MP at the end of the wearer’s turn.

policy.description: Restores HP to the wearer after their action defeats an enemy.
policy.limiter: Once per originating action, even when several enemies are defeated.

policy.description: Restores MP to the wearer after their action defeats an enemy.
policy.limiter: Once per originating action; no party-wide credit or recursive procs.

policy.description: Restores HP from eligible direct physical damage actually dealt.
policy.limiter: Per-action recovery cap; excludes excess damage, metal-hunting exceptions and triggered damage.

policy.description: Increases eligible healing received; equipment regeneration and Life Steal are excluded.
policy.limiter: No healing-trigger feedback loop.

policy.description: Reduces MP spent on eligible actions; does not grant spells or skills.
policy.limiter: A positive cost remains positive; no negative costs.

policy.description: Improves healing items used by the wearer; excludes seeds, resurrection and permanent progression items.
policy.limiter: No effect on item quantity, non-healing rewards or permanent stats.

policy.description: Reduces eligible incoming physical damage; shares the mitigation policy with native effects.
Reduces eligible incoming spell damage; shares the mitigation policy with native effects.
Restores HP after the wearer successfully blocks an incoming attack.
policy.limiter: Once per incoming enemy action; no recursion.

policy.description: Dodging grants a damage bonus to the next eligible action before the end of the wearer’s next turn.
policy.limiter: One non-stacking charge, consumed once per action; expires.

policy.description: Restores MP after an eligible physical critical hit.
policy.limiter: Once per originating action, regardless of number of critical hits.
